operating_notes.text: AUM crossed ₹15,000 Cr to ₹15,303.86 Cr at 31 March 2026, with consolidated disbursements of ₹4,267.24 Cr in Q4FY26.
Impairment on financial instruments was ₹179.78 Cr for FY26 against ₹128.38 Cr in FY25.
The Group includes MAS Rural Housing & Mortgage Finance Limited and MASFIN Insurance Broking Private Limited as subsidiaries.
Consolidated AUM crossed ₹15,000 Cr to reach ₹15,303.86 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
Consolidated AUM ₹15,303.86 Cr at 31 March 2026, up ~19% YoY; standalone AUM ₹14,363.7 Cr.
Cost of borrowing 9.60% in FY26 (FY25: 9.88%) and 9.39% in Q4FY26 (Q4FY25: 9.81%).
Around 80% of the portfolio is MSME loans qualifying as priority sector lending; company aims to keep 20%-25% of AUM off book via direct assignment and co-lending.
Consolidated AUM crossed ₹15,000 Cr to reach ₹15,304 Cr in FY26.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹542.47 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹103.12 Cr (+25.0% YoY).
MAS Financial Services announced FY26 results with consolidated AUM crossing ₹15,000 Cr and PAT reaching ₹379.41 Cr.
MAS Financial targets 20-25% AUM growth, 2.75-3.00% ROA; FY26 AUM ₹15,304 Cr, up 19%
Acuite assigned and reaffirmed MAS Financial Services' credit ratings at ACUITE AA Stable and withdrew the ₹300 Cr commercial paper rating.
MAS Financial reported FY26 consolidated AUM of ₹15,304 Cr and PAT of ₹379 Cr, up 21% YoY.
MAS Financial's audit committee reviewed a 30-share contra trade by Treasury Head Bhavna Bhatt on May 06, 2026, found it inadvertent and profitless, and issued a warning letter.
MAS Financial Services raised ₹360 Cr through NCDs issued to FMO.
MAS Financial promoters reported holding 66.65% equity shares with zero encumbrance for the year ended March 31, 2026.
